study.description: Eleven well-known swing and trend-following strategies, long-only (spot) or long and short (futures), on ten major Binance coins at 1 hour, 4 hours and 1 day. Each variant is chosen on the first two years and judged on the last year, risking 2% of the account per trade without leverage, and compared month by month with buying and holding the same coins.

families.idea: The Turtle rules: buy a close above the highest high of the last N candles, sell when price closes below the low of a shorter channel. Mirrored for shorts.
families.name: Donchian channel breakout

families.idea: Buy when the fast EMA crosses above the slow one, get out when it crosses back.
families.name: Moving average crossover

families.idea: Buy when SuperTrend flips up, get out when it flips down.
families.name: SuperTrend flip

families.idea: Time-series momentum: hold while price is above its N-candle average.
families.name: Price crosses its moving average

families.idea: Buy a close through last week's high; get out below last week's low.
families.name: Weekly high breakout

families.idea: Buy a close above the upper Keltner band, get out below the middle.
families.name: Keltner channel breakout

families.idea: MACD crosses its signal line in the direction of the 200 EMA.
families.name: MACD cross with the trend

families.idea: Larry Connors' rule: above the 200 average, buy when 2-period RSI is deeply oversold, sell on a close above the 5 average.
families.name: RSI(2) pullback in an uptrend

families.idea: When ADX says there's no trend, buy a close below the lower band and sell at the middle.
families.name: Bollinger reversion in quiet markets

families.idea: Above the 200 EMA, buy when RSI(14) turns back up through 40; sell above 70 or if the trend breaks.
families.name: RSI pullback in a trend

families.idea: Study 1's pin bar at a swing low or high, only in the direction of the 200 EMA, with a 2R target.
families.name: Pin bar at swing level with the trend

strategy.name: Pin bar at swing level with the trend

study.name: Swing and trend strategies for monthly profit
